title: Review-before-action turns signals into safe next steps
subtitle: Client activity is condensed into proposals that remain inside a human approval loop before execution.

nodes.label: Client signals
nodes.detail: Searches, chats, alerts, and listing changes enter the loop

nodes.label: Daily digest
nodes.detail: Activity is consolidated into a current client picture

nodes.label: Proposed next step
nodes.detail: AI refines a search or prepares draft outreach

nodes.label: Agent review
nodes.detail: A professional checks fit, tone, timing, and intent

nodes.label: Approved action
nodes.detail: Only reviewed work crosses the execution boundary

nodes.label: Client response
nodes.detail: New behavior and feedback inform the next cycle

callouts.label: Signal compression
callouts.detail: Scattered activity becomes one reviewable decision surface.

callouts.label: Authority boundary
callouts.detail: Recommendation is automated; consequential approval remains human.

callouts.label: Learning loop
callouts.detail: Results return as fresh context without bypassing review.

footer: The loop reduces coordination work without silently transferring professional authority.
